svg.text: W18 · Members of an organisation: invite, change roles, remove · AWK-30 · 2026-10-15
Owners and admins bring colleagues in by email or with a link, set what each may do, and take them out again. Every step is in the audit log.
A · Organisation menu → Members (owners and admins) · EN
(folded: Owner everything · Admin members, look, domains, API · Editor surveys · Analyst results and exports · Viewer results)
Dražan Kosić · Oct 13 · valid 5 more days
B · Invite members, one step · DE
Der Link gilt 7 Tage. Wer noch kein Konto hat, legt beim
ersten Öffnen Name und Passwort fest.
Without email set up: “Email is not set up yet” and Make 2 links, each to copy (as for participants).
Partner Ltd stays; switch in the organisation menu.
Owners and admins then set up two-factor (required for them); other roles get it offered, not required.
· A role changes at once from the list; the person sees it on their next click.
· There is always at least one owner: the last owner cannot be changed or removed.
· Only owners make or change owners. Admins manage everyone else.
· Remove… asks first: “Remove Ben Huber from Acme GmbH? Their surveys and results stay.”
· Leave organisation… in the organisation menu for oneself (not the last owner).
· A removed member's sessions in this organisation end at once.
1 Members is in the organisation menu for owners and admins, next to Look, Messages, Domains and API. It uses the shared data grid (sorting, phone cards).
2 The role is a dropdown in the row; your own row and, for admins, owners' rows are read-only.
3 ⋯ holds Remove… (and Send two-factor reset, later). Nothing else; the person edits their own name and security on Account.
4 Open invitations sit under the list: Copy link, Send again, Revoke. A link works once and for 7 days.
5 One step: addresses (one per line, checked as you type), one role for all of them, Editor preselected.
6 The link either creates the account (name and password, email fixed by the invitation) or adds the organisation to an existing one.
7 Rules that keep an organisation safe: at least one owner, owners managed only by owners, removal asks first and ends sessions.
8 Every step is in the organisation's audit log.
Email: the invitation uses the organisation's look (Messages), like participant invitations. PDF: not involved.
Open for Dražan: (a) invitation links valid 7 days (recommended) or 14; (b) admins may invite and change every role except owner (recommended),
or only owners manage members; (c) when a host system manages members (AWK-12), this page only shows them (recommended).
